title: Disaster-recovery critical path
method: Synthetic sequential critical path totaling fifty-five minutes against a sixty-minute objective. Four minutes of recovery-point lag is a separate measure and is not added to recovery time. Real concurrent stages require a dependency graph.
alt: Disaster-recovery critical path: Declare recovery 10 minutes, Promote data 15 minutes, Start and warm capacity 20 minutes, Validate business path 10 minutes. Illustrative inputs.
